name: Hoshi no Furusato -Stardust Memories-
source:
Main character loses memory after an accident and returns to his hometown to regain his memory. Through conversations with cute girls there he starts to recover, but at the same time he realizes the promises he made long time ago.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在事故中失去记忆，返回故乡寻找恢复记忆的方法。通过与当地可爱女孩们交谈，他开始逐渐回想起来，同时也意识到自己很久以前许下的约定。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
